Knobby Wednesday

Boulder, CO · North Boulder · Mountain bike

Knobby Wednesday is a mountain bike group ride in Boulder, CO. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Boulder Valley Ranch.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 5:30 PM MDT
Host's website↗ Add to calendar→ Google Calendar Text it · WhatsApp · Email

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed on the host's own page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

BMA's group rides page (fetched Oct 1, 2026) says rides run April through September and lists Knobby Wednesday as Wednesdays at 6:00 pm in season; the Oct 2026 Meetup feed shows a co-ed Nite Ride on Wed Oct 21 and no Knobby Wednesday.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: laid-back, aerobic 4/10, technical 3/10. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @boulderbma the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Knobby Wednesday group ride

The Boulder Mountainbike Alliance's beginner-friendly weekly ride on smooth, non-technical trails. Coed and no-drop: the group stops at every intersection and waits. Good first trail ride.
